study type: Prospective, randomized, parallel assignment, triple-blinded controlled trial
exposure: Ropivacaine with dexmedetomidine in TAP block
outcome: Visual analog scale (VAS)-R (pain score at rest)
Visual analog scale (VAS)-C (pain score on coughing)
Short Assessment of Patient Satisfaction Score (SAPS)
cohort: One hundred patients undergoing elective lower segment cesarean section.
finding: The addition of dexmedetomidine to ropivacaine in TAP block significantly increased the duration of postoperative analgesia up to 18 hours and improved patient satisfaction regarding analgesia quality in patients undergoing elective lower segment cesarean section.
